title: Agriculture 4.0 Innovation for Food Security: Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho UGM Shares Insights at UNS & Ministry of Agriculture National Workshop
excerpt: Yogyakarta, 26 November 2025 – The Research Institute and Community Service (LPPM) of Universitas Sebelas Maret (UNS) in collaboration with the Extension and Agricultural Human Resource Development Agency of the Ministry of Agriculture through the YESS Program, successfully held a National Workshop Through Modern Agriculture. body:
**Yogyakarta, 26 November 2025** – The Research Institute and Community Service (LPPM) of Universitas Sebelas Maret (UNS) in collaboration with the Extension and Agricultural Human Resource Development Agency of the Ministry of Agriculture through the YESS Program, successfully held a National Workshop Through Modern Agriculture. The activity held at Hotel New Saphire Yogyakarta featured Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, S.T.P., M.Sc., Ph.D., IPU., ASEAN Eng., APEC Eng., lecturer and researcher at the Department of Agricultural Engineering and Biosystems, Faculty of Agricultural Technology at Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM), as the main speaker for the session on 26 November 2025.

This national workshop is a strategic initiative to accelerate the transformation of Indonesia's agricultural sector toward the digital era, with a focus on integrating Smart Farming innovations and Agriculture 4.0. Its objective is to increase production efficiency, optimize resource use, and strengthen sustainable and globally competitive national food security. This theme serves as the foundation for collaboration on technology innovation and knowledge to build a resilient and adaptive future for Indonesian agriculture.

In his presentation titled "Smart Farming and Agriculture 4.0 Innovation: Keys to Increasing Production Efficiency and National Food Security", Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho comprehensively discussed the concepts, potential, and implementation of advanced technologies such as Internet of Things (IoT), Artificial Intelligence (AI), Big Data Analytics, Automation, and Robotics in the context of modern agriculture. He emphasized how these technologies can be a solution to current national agricultural challenges, including land limitations, the impacts of climate change, and the urgent need to increase productivity. Workshop participants, from various backgrounds, gained in-depth understanding of the main pillars of Agriculture 4.0 and its impact on resource efficiency, productivity improvement, and reduction of post-harvest losses.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/583-1-image-3-1030x686.webp)

The session also highlighted case studies of innovation implementation in Indonesia, including UGM's Smart Agriculture project, as well as government and private sector initiatives in agricultural digitalization. Dr. Andri also discussed major challenges in innovation adoption, such as digital infrastructure gaps and farmers' technical literacy, as well as strategies to overcome them through infrastructure investment, financing schemes, and comprehensive training programs. The discussion and question-and-answer session was highly interactive, demonstrating participants' enthusiasm for the topic.

**Support for Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**

The "National Workshop Through Modern Agriculture" activity directly contributes to several United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs):

– SDG 2: Zero Hunger: By promoting Smart Farming and Agriculture 4.0 to improve production efficiency, this workshop supports efforts to achieve national food security and reduce hunger.

– SDG 4: Quality Education: Through the transfer of knowledge about cutting-edge agricultural technology, this activity enhances participants' competence in agricultural digitalization, equipping them with relevant skills for the future.

– SDG 9: Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure: The focus on integrating advanced technology and innovation in agriculture aligns with the goal of building robust infrastructure, promoting inclusive and sustainable industrialization, and fostering innovation.

– SDG 17: Partnerships for the Goals: Collaboration among Universitas Gadjah Mada, Universitas Sebelas Maret, the Ministry of Agriculture, and the YESS Program demonstrates the importance of multi-stakeholder partnerships in achieving sustainable development goals.

Through this workshop, it is hoped that participants can become agents of change inspired to adopt and develop Agriculture 4.0 innovations, thereby enabling Indonesian agriculture to become more modern, efficient, sustainable, and globally competitive for the sake of robust national food security.

original.body:
**Yogyakarta, 26 November 2025** – Lembaga Penelitian dan Pengabdian kepada Masyarakat (LPPM) Universitas Sebelas Maret (UNS) bekerjasama dengan Badan Penyuluhan dan Pengembangan Sumber Daya Manusia Pertanian Kementerian Pertanian melalui Program YESS, sukses menyelenggarakan National Workshop Through Modern Agriculture. Kegiatan yang berlangsung di Hotel New Saphire Yogyakarta ini menghadirkan Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, S.T.P., M.Sc., Ph.D., IPU., ASEAN Eng., APEC Eng., dosen dan peneliti Departemen Teknik Pertanian dan Biosistem, Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM), sebagai narasumber utama pada sesi tanggal 26 November 2025.

Workshop nasional ini merupakan inisiatif strategis untuk mengakselerasi transformasi sektor pertanian Indonesia menuju era digital, dengan fokus pada integrasi inovasi Smart Farming dan Agriculture 4.0. Tujuannya adalah untuk meningkatkan efisiensi produksi, mengoptimalkan penggunaan sumber daya, dan memperkuat ketahanan pangan nasional yang berkelanjutan dan berdaya saing global. Tema ini menjadi landasan bagi kolaborasi inovasi teknologi dan pengetahuan untuk membangun masa depan pertanian Indonesia yang tangguh dan adaptif.

Dalam paparannya yang berjudul “Inovasi Smart Farming dan Agriculture 4.0: Kunci Peningkatan Efisiensi Produksi dan Ketahanan Pangan Nasional”, Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho mengupas tuntas konsep, potensi, serta implementasi teknologi canggih seperti Internet of Things (IoT), Kecerdasan Buatan (AI), Big Data Analytics, Otomasi, dan Robotika dalam konteks pertanian modern. Beliau menekankan bagaimana teknologi ini dapat menjadi solusi atas tantangan pertanian nasional saat ini, termasuk keterbatasan lahan, dampak perubahan iklim, dan kebutuhan mendesak akan peningkatan produktivitas. Peserta workshop, yang terdiri dari berbagai latar belakang, mendapatkan pemahaman mendalam mengenai pilar-pilar utama Agriculture 4.0 dan dampaknya terhadap efisiensi sumber daya, peningkatan produktivitas, serta pengurangan kerugian pasca panen.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/583-1-image-3-1030x686.webp)

Sesi ini juga menyoroti studi kasus implementasi inovasi di Indonesia, termasuk proyek Smart Agriculture UGM, serta inisiatif pemerintah dan swasta dalam digitalisasi pertanian. Dr. Andri juga membahas tantangan utama dalam adopsi inovasi, seperti kesenjangan infrastruktur digital dan literasi teknis petani, serta strategi untuk mengatasinya melalui investasi infrastruktur, skema pembiayaan, dan program pelatihan komprehensif. Sesi diskusi dan tanya jawab berlangsung interaktif, menunjukkan antusiasme peserta terhadap topik ini.

**Dukungan Terhadap Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan (SDGs)**

Kegiatan “National Workshop Through Modern Agriculture” ini secara langsung berkontribusi pada beberapa Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan (Sustainable Development Goals/SDGs) PBB:

– SDG 2: Tanpa Kelaparan (Zero Hunger): Dengan mempromosikan Smart Farming dan Agriculture 4.0 untuk peningkatan efisiensi produksi, workshop ini mendukung upaya mewujudkan ketahanan pangan nasional dan mengurangi kelaparan.

– SDG 4: Pendidikan Berkualitas (Quality Education): Melalui transfer pengetahuan tentang teknologi pertanian terkini, kegiatan ini meningkatkan kompetensi peserta dalam bidang digitalisasi pertanian, membekali mereka dengan keterampilan relevan untuk masa depan.

– SDG 9: Industri, Inovasi, dan Infrastruktur (Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure): Fokus pada integrasi teknologi canggih dan inovasi dalam pertanian sejalan dengan tujuan membangun infrastruktur yang tangguh, mendorong industrialisasi inklusif dan berkelanjutan, serta memupuk inovasi.

– SDG 17: Kemitraan untuk Mencapai Tujuan (Partnerships for the Goals): Kolaborasi antara Universitas Gadjah Mada, Universitas Sebelas Maret, Kementerian Pertanian, dan Program YESS menunjukkan pentingnya kemitraan multi-pihak untuk mencapai tujuan pembangunan berkelanjutan.

Melalui workshop ini, diharapkan para peserta dapat menjadi agen perubahan yang terinspirasi untuk mengadopsi dan mengembangkan inovasi pertanian 4.0, sehingga mampu mewujudkan pertanian Indonesia yang lebih modern, efisien, berkelanjutan, dan berdaya saing global demi ketahanan pangan nasional yang kokoh.
